title: Miami's Golden Door Shakes Up Nightlife with Star-Studded Debut, Featuring 50 Cent and More | User | minstercommunitypost.com
text:
Boom! Golden Door just dropped into Miami's nightlife like a bombshell-delivering glitz, glam, and a guest list that read like a celebrity power ranking. Miami’s nightlife just hit the jackpot with the grand debut of Golden Door , the city’s latest upscale lounge that perfectly blends top-tier entertainment, world-class dining, and an exclusive atmosphere designed for high-powered meetings and unforgettable nights out. In no time, Golden Door has emerged as a must-visit hotspot for celebrities, with none other than 50 Cent spotted multiple times, adding his star power to the already buzzing venue.
Golden Door isn't just a lounge—it’s a sensation. Its grand opening made waves in the Miami nightlife scene, delivering glitz, glam, and a guest list packed with A-list names. The night was kicked off by performance artist and influencer Ziggy Zeiger , who welcomed guests as host, setting the tone for what was nothing short of a magical evening.
With 50 Cent rocking the mic and luminaries like Gene Borello, Buckwheat, TMZ DJ Chang3, Todd English, Roy Jones Jr., Matt Philliben, Roger Sanchez, and Vlada lighting up the red carpet, it was clear: Golden Door is the after-dark destination in Miami.
Guests were treated to world-class entertainment, including a jaw-dropping performance by Crazy Horse Paris, the iconic cabaret known for its blend of art, dance, and sensuality. The evening continued with the exclusive Branson Cognac King’s Table Dinner Party, offering guests an unforgettable experience of premium dining.
Behind this spectacular success are visionaries Billy Karasik and Maxim Vergun, the masterminds who have elevated Miami's social scene. Together, they’ve created more than just a venue—they’ve established the city’s new epicenter of style, status, and celebration.
Billy Karasik, a seasoned impresario, has redefined luxury entertainment with a career spanning New York and Miami. His expertise has shaped exclusive culinary and nightlife experiences, including Red Wine with Fish Gourmet Kitchens and Green Room, a members-only Soho nightclub frequented by celebrities and fashion moguls. His unmatched ability to curate immersive, high-touch experiences has cemented his reputation in the luxury entertainment world.
Maxim Vergun, a nightlife maestro, has propelled Golden Door (formerly Maze Lounge) to the pinnacle of Miami’s elite social scene. Known for orchestrating some of the city’s most star-studded nights, Vergun has secured performances from music icons like DJ Khaled, Rick Ross, Meek Mill, Afrojack, and Steve Aoki. His skill in executing unforgettable events has made Maze Lounge the go-to spot for high-profile events like Miami Swim Week and Art Basel after parties, attracting a global audience of cultural elites.
With Golden Door, Karasik and Vergun have created the ultimate destination for those seeking to experience Miami’s nightlife at its finest.
